topic.title: Using Classes from the Java Library

sections.title: What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Ready to learn **Using Classes from the Java Library**?

Here's what we'll cover:

• Working with built-in Java classes
• Why this matters for your coding journey
• Hands-on examples you can try

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content:
Think of **Using Classes from the Java Library** like building blocks. 

Every great program starts with small, simple pieces. This is one of those essential pieces!

• Start simple, then build up
• Practice makes it click
• Don't worry if it takes time - totally normal!

sections.title: Code Examples
Key Points
points: The Java API provides thousands of pre-built classes for common tasks
The Date class represents a specific point in time
The Random class generates pseudo-random numbers of various types
Use import statements to access classes from specific packages
Reading API documentation is essential for using library classes effectively

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: Using Classes from the Java Library - Working with built-in Java classes. Master basics before advancing. Practice with the examples. Builds foundation for what's next.
